name: autour_one
description: Autour One is inspired by handwritten letters on Ludwig Hohlwein posters. It has been changed and adapted from the originals in a variety of ways so that it will work in paragraphs of text and on the web. Autour One can be used a in a wide range of sizes. Autour means 'round' in French.
